text:
5 stars for the doctor, nurses, and reception staff 💐😊😇

My family and I have been patients here for over 10 years, receiving treatments like teeth cleaning, fillings, and crowns. The doctor is skilled, kind, and very good, and the nurses are all lovely. The reception staff are all excellent...except for the current manager. We've had two unpleasant phone calls from the manager.

A year ago, I gave a rating and complained about the person who answered my dental appointment call. That's when I found out it was the manager.

On May 20th, I called to schedule a consultation for a new crown. A staff member answered and scheduled an appointment for the 21st at 2 PM.
After the call, they asked me if I, a customer who had previously given a rating and complained about a staff member, was going to return to the clinic?! (That's when I realized it was the same manager.)
I was confused and said, "What? It happened a year ago, and I've forgotten about it."
They said they remembered me.
I replied, "Actually, if it was true, you should accept it and fix it." This isn't to blame the customer again.
He: He's just a low-level employee. (He blamed us as if we had deliberately wronged him.)
We: If you talk like that, we're not okay with it. You should improve your own work performance for making a mistake with the appointment, not blame the customer.

We also said that if that's the case, we won't go anymore.
But he insisted that the appointment was for May 21st at 2 PM...but it was his day off...we didn't respond.

In short, we didn't go, and no employee called to reconfirm. We also assumed that he probably didn't record the appointment time. ***We're not blaming the employee for not calling.

We went to another clinic instead; there are many dental clinics.

...The management can listen to this phone conversation...
As mentioned, the conversation will be recorded to improve future services.
We are adults, mature enough, never demanding, and would never deliberately harm an employee. We understand the feelings of a working person. We've been a patient here for over 10 years. Honestly, we're very disappointed.
All the doctors and staff are excellent.
Thank you.💐🌼
